hits.text:
[page 1]
Graph Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction
DOI: 10.1234/example.gcn.2025
## Abstract
We survey graph neural network architectures for molecular property prediction from SMILES and molecular
## Methods
Edge-conditioned convolution encodes atoms as nodes and bonds as edges. We evaluate on QM9 with an M
## Results
On QM9, the GNN reduces mean absolute error by 12 percent relative to MLP.
## Limitations
The model does not handle stereochemistry beyond two dimensions.
## Reproducibility
Canonical version with final administrative approval.
